{'text': '據報 Apple 新推出的 HomeView 多年來其實已大致完成，卻一直遭到延期。以下是根據 Apple 重要高層的言論，解釋 HomeView 為何直到現在才能夠正式推出。', 'paragraph_context': 'Apple’s new HomeView was reportedly mostly finished for years, but kept getting delayed. Here’s why HomeView couldn’t launch until now, per quotes from key Apple execs.'}

{'text': 'Apple 強調具備個人化資訊及對話能力的 Siri AI，是 HomeView 不可或缺的一部分', 'paragraph_context': 'Apple touts Siri AI with personal context and conversational abilities as essential to HomeView'}

{'text': '2024年11月，Mark Gurman 發表了一篇有關現時稱為 HomeView 的產品的深度報道。當時他指 Apple 目標是在2025年3月推出。然而日期一再推遲，HomeView 最終要到2026年11月13日才能正式進入用戶家中。', 'paragraph_context': 'In November 2024, Mark Gurman published an in-depth report on the product we now know as HomeView. At the time, he said Apple was targeting a March 2025 launch. But that date kept slipping, and now HomeView will finally arrive in homes on November 13, 2026.'}

{'text': '為何要等這麼久？Gurman 多次指出 Siri AI 是延期的主要原因。而 Apple 高層在接受 The Verge 訪問時亦大致確認了這一點。', 'paragraph_context': 'Why the long wait? Gurman has repeatedly pointed to Siri AI as the chief cause of delays. And Apple execs have now largely confirmed that in quotes given to The Verge.'}

{'text': 'Jennifer Pattison Tuohy 向 Apple 家居產品行銷副總裁 Kaiann Drance 提問，為何現在才是推出 HomeView 及重整智能家居策略的合適時機。', 'paragraph_context': 'Jennifer Pattison Tuohy asked Kaiann Drance, Apple’s VP of product marketing for home, why now was the right time for HomeView and Apple’s renewed smart home push.'}

{'text': '她表示，Siri AI 及其帶來的個人化資訊——她稱之為 Apple 的「私隱理念」——與一款專為家居設計的裝置終於結合起來。「憑藉 Siri AI 的魔力，它以一種我們過去無法實現的方式整合在一起，」她說。', 'paragraph_context': 'She said Siri AI and the personal context it brings, which she called Apple’s “privacy story,” came together with a device designed specifically for the home. “With the magic of Siri AI, it comes together in a way that we haven’t been able to deliver before,” she said.'}

{'text': 'HomeView 被定位為一款共享裝置，能夠以前所未有的方式運用 Siri AI 帶來的用戶個人化資訊。因此不難想像，如果缺乏更個人化的 Siri，Apple 的主要賣點將不得不改變。', 'paragraph_context': 'HomeView is being marketed as a shared device that taps into users’ personal context in a way that wasn’t possible pre-Siri AI. So it’s easy to see how Apple’s main pitch would need to change without the more personalized Siri.'}

{'text': 'Apple AI 產品行銷副總裁 Lilian Rincon 亦給出了類似的解釋。她向 The Verge 表示，Siri AI 是 HomeView 的核心，因為它「更為強大」，並強調其對話能力令家中任何成員都能輕鬆使用。', 'paragraph_context': 'A similar explanation was given by Apple’s Lilian Rincon, VP of product marketing for AI. She told The Verge that Siri AI is core to HomeView because it’s “much more capable” and also highlighted its conversational abilities, which make it easy to use for any family member.'}

{'text': '「它很棒，因為你可以用非常自然的方式叫它調校恆溫器的溫度。隨着 Siri AI 的功能不斷演進，家庭體驗亦正適合以這種自然的方式來互動。」談到為何是現在推出時，Rincon 表示，由自然語言驅動的轉變正是 AI 走向主流的時刻。「因為現在它可以⋯⋯無論是我奶奶還是在讀大學的 Z 世代，他們都能用自己自然的說話方式去使用並得到想要的結果。」', 'paragraph_context': '“It’s great because you can just ask it to change the temperature on your thermostat in a very natural way. As the Siri AI capabilities continue to evolve, the home experience is fitting to be able to interact with in this natural way.” On why now, Rincon says the natural-language shift is the point where AI goes mainstream. “Because now it can be … my mother-in-law or the Gen Z who’s in college, both of them can use this in the way that they naturally speak and get what they want.”'}

{'text': 'Pete 留言獲最多讚好', 'paragraph_context': 'Top comment by Pete'}

{'text': '叫 Siri 播放音樂時，佢連外國藝術家嘅名都聽唔明。', 'paragraph_context': "Siri doesn't even understand names of foreign artists when you ask it to play music."}

{'text': '這種強調與解釋，亦令 HomeView 未在歐盟推出變得更加容易理解。', 'paragraph_context': 'This emphasis and explanation also makes HomeView’s absence in the EU more understandable.'}

{'text': '如果 Siri AI 只是在一款功能豐富的產品上錦上添花，或許仍可在歐盟推出。但如果整個產品的核心價值都圍繞着這款新助理及其個人化功能，那麼等到 Siri AI 能在歐盟的 iOS 上使用才推出便更為合理。', 'paragraph_context': 'If Siri AI was simply a nice-to-have addition to an otherwise feature-rich product, perhaps it could launch in the EU still. But if the whole value proposition revolves around the new assistant and its personalized features, waiting until Siri AI is available for iOS in the EU makes more sense.'}

{'text': '如欲了解更多引言及背景資料，請按此閱讀 The Verge 的完整報道。', 'paragraph_context': 'You can read The Verge’s full article here for more quotes and context.'}
